title: Langley incursions and Goldwater Range flashing lights videos
place_text: Langley AFB, Virginia; Goldwater Training Range, Arizona

tellings.quote: um the Langley incursions. If you there's a there's witness video where the guy zooms out and you can see I don't know 10 15 flashing light

plain: In the 2020s, unknown objects are said to have entered the airspace over Langley Air Force Base in Virginia, and lights were filmed over the Goldwater Range, a military training area in Arizona. Marik von Rennenkampff brings these cases up as examples, without naming a source. He describes a video filmed by a witness: the man zooms out, and you can see "10, 15 flashing lights."
